prompt:
Pixel art for a 16-bit style side-view arena shooter that runs at 640x360. Edit the attached template in place: it is drawn on a chunky pixel grid where one art pixel is exactly 1/240 of the image width; keep exactly that pixel size (never finer, never subdivided), and keep every size anchor and guide position. Crisp hard pixels: a clean 1-pixel near-black outline around every character, Enemy and prop; flat cel shading with 3-4 tones per material, shadows leaning purple-blue and highlights leaning warm yellow, light from the upper left; no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no soft edges, no semi-transparent pixels (use a checkerboard dither for any in-between tone). Characters are seen in a three-quarter side view (Metal Slug style): facing right, head and chest turned slightly toward the viewer. No text, no watermark, no shadows on the ground unless asked.

The attached image is one 240x135 tile of the Arena backdrop, a 640x360 opaque side-view scene, drawn as a flat draft at its exact in-game pixel size. The Arena is a city plaza at sunset between a classical columned courthouse (left) and the glass Bufete & Pesas S.A. tower (right), with the Boissons cocktail bar on the plaza between them.

This tile: the middle right of the scene: the glass curtain-wall tower of Bufete & Pesas S.A.: a grid of blue glass panes in a steel frame reflecting the warm sunset on its left edge, a shaded side face on the right, a blank dark name plate overhanging the facade, and the top of the entrance canopy; the distant skyline and sunset sky at both edges, and the top of the Boissons bar at the left edge.

Redraw this tile in place as crisp, finished, professional pixel art (modern commercial 16-bit quality), at exactly the same pixel size and composition. Every shape stays exactly where it is, within one pixel, so this tile joins its neighbours: the same silhouettes, edges, window grids and horizon lines. Keep the colours and the warm sunset light from the left. Add hand-placed detail: sunset reflections and diagonal sheens on the glass panes, crisp steel mullions and spandrel bands, a darker cool side face, bolts on the name plate, and distant tiny lit windows. Leave the name plate completely blank and flat (its lettering is added later). A dark 1-pixel outline only where a building meets the sky. Opaque scene: fill the whole frame edge to edge, no border, no white background, no text.
